jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Commodity Manager Expediting (f/m/d) within Gas Services Procurement, you will ensure the execution of the business growth, timely as well as qualitative delivery of critical components by proactively monitoring supplier progress and coordinating 3rd party expediting/ inspection activities across the global supply chain. to maintain supply continuity and support production schedules.How You’ll Make an Impact * Coordinate global resource allocation, demand, and deployment of expediting and inspection services, including third-party services, for the NewApp and Services business of Gas Services Central* Monitor supplier capacity utilization, production progress, and manufacturing schedules, coordinating on-site expediting and inspections to secure delivery and quality commitments and ensure on-time delivery of critical components* Identify supply chain bottlenecks and risks early, develop recovery plans, drive corrective actions, and support alternative sourcing and logistics solutions in collaboration with Product Lines* Coordinate with Product Lines, Commodity Management, Logistics, Quality, and Engineering to resolve technical, operational, and administrative issues affecting supplier deliveries, escalating critical supplier performance issues when required* Track supplier performance, maintain expediting tools and KPIs, and prepare regular status reports and risk assessments for procurement leadership and project stakeholders.* Analyze delivery performance and supply chain data to identify improvement opportunities, support supplier development, and contribute to long-term commodity strategiesWhat You Bring* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business environment, preferably in the energy or heavy machinery sector* Strong knowledge of supplier performance management, production planning, delivery scheduling, logistics, and supply chain risk mitigation* Experience in contract management, supplier negotiations, and resolving delivery-related issues in close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders* Strong analytical and communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluent German and English skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with local and international suppliersAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. jobs.occupation: PostDoc in Drug Discovery / Neutrophil-driven Inflammation  (m/w/d) (Naturwissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description: Scope of dutiesAs a PostDoc in the research group of Prof. Christoph Klein, you will join a translational research program with the option to take on a leadership role.You will be involved in a first-in-class drug discovery project aimed at selectively modulating neutrophil-driven inflammation. Your work will cover the differentiation and functional characterization of iPSC-derived neutrophils, the establishment and execution of biochemical and cellular screening assays, as well as multi-omics profiling (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics) in collaboration with our academic and industrial partners.You will help plan and coordinate ongoing experiments, prepare scientific data for publication and grant applications, and support the scientific supervision of junior researchers.Our requirements· Completed PhD in Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmacology or a comparable field· Solid experience in the following areas:· Molecular biology and cell biology techniques· iPSC cultivation and/or differentiation into immune cell types· Establishment and execution of biochemical, cellular or high-throughput screening assays· Experience with in vitro or in vivo functional assays and multi-omics data analysis is an advantage· The ability to work independently, as well as in an interdisciplinary and international team· A structured, meticulous and solution-oriented working style· Excellent English skills; German skills are an advantageOur offer· The position is initially funded for two years . Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension is possible· An innovative and challenging position within the research group of Prof. Christoph Klein, operating at the interface of translational immunotherapy, stem cell biology and precision medicine.· An international and interdisciplinary research environment, supported by close collaboration with academic and industrial partners within an established research network· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists on two complementary translational projects· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement (TV-L), including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations

Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension is possible· An innovative and challenging position within the research group of Prof. Christoph Klein, operating at the interface of translational immunotherapy, stem cell biology and precision medicine.· An international and interdisciplinary research environment, supported by close collaboration with academic and industrial partners within an established research network· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists on two complementary translational projects· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement (TV-L), including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations

identifying and shaping complex business ideas across single projects and business domains where technology can provide a new, transformative approach to an existing business problem.- Setting up, planning and managing IT projects in cooperation with various other IT units  the clients and stakeholders, following the established MR standards.- Managing and being responsible for the implementation of requirements in an agile project setup.- Analysing and supporting the implementation of non-functional requirements like compliance, IT security, resilience and operations.- responsible for cost estimates and compliance gates.- Responsible for project budget and cost management.Your Profile- University degree, preferably in Mathematics or Information Technology, or an stakeholders, peers and team members.- Willingness to travel.- Fluent command of business English.Application InstructionsIn order to consider your application, we require your application to be Evaluate and implement state-of-the-art methods, tools, and ways of working to keep them effective and current.- Collaborate across product, engineering, quality and maintain current application-security and medical-device cybersecurity expertise.- Success in this role means that product security is demonstrably embedded in the medical software lifecycle, security risks are addressed transparently and proportionately, and the organization remains prepared for audits, evolving threats, and post-market obligations.You're the right fit if:- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable discipline.- Hands-on software development and coding experience is expected, enabling you to review code and engage with engineering teams at a technical level.- Experience in product or application security for regulated or safety-critical software, covering secure architecture, risk and vulnerability management, testing, secure development practices and tooling, with the ability to provide actionable guidance to engineering teams.- Having worked in a regulated environmentExperience creating and improving controlled quality management system processes, procedures, and work instructions, and supporting internal and external audits or assessments by notified bodies, regulators, customers, or certification organizations.- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to support technical and non-technical stakeholders.- A structured, evidence-based, and pragmatic working style, with a proactive mindset, and the initiative to identify needs and to actively drive improvements forward.- Relevant security certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, or comparable credentials, are an advantage.Compensation & benefitsYou combine strong technical expertise with a proactive and structured working style. You are comfortable coordinating stakeholders from different disciplines, making sound engineering decisions, and driving change in a complex, quality-driven environment. jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at its Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) in Müncheberg  starting as of 1 January 2027Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect(part time, 65%)Location: Müncheberg (Brandenburg)Employment scope: part-time, 65% (26 weekly working hours)Type of contract: ideally starting on 01 January 2027; fixed term until 31 December 2030Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.Located east of Berlin, the Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) is situated on a modern science campus. An international team of scientists conducts insect research, complemented by an information centre with archive and library.About the projectExploring insect communities with molecular tools. How do crop resilience strategies affect insect communities - and how can molecular technologies help us monitor these changes directly in the field?As a PhD Researcher in the collaborative project SiProtect, you will investigate insect communities associated with rye and contribute to the development of innovative approaches for species identification and biodiversity monitoring.SiProtect explores how amorphous silicate (ASi) can strengthen rye resilience to biotic and abiotic stressors, including insect pests, associated pathogens and drought. Your research will connect field-based entomological monitoring with molecular identification, metabarcoding and portable nanopore sequencing.A particular focus will be the development and validation of a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION technology. The resulting workflow aims to accelerate species identification under field conditions and provide a transferable approach for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring.Your tasks- Plan and conduct entomological research activities within the SiProtect research programme, with a focus on insect communities associated with rye- Conduct standardised insect monitoring using Malaise traps, pan traps, sticky traps and sweep netting- Identify collected insects using morphological and taxonomic approaches and contribute to a reference database for rye-associated insect communities- Establish, optimise and validate metabarcoding approaches for bulk insect samples and compare their performance with conventional identification methods- Portable sequencing: Develop and validate a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing for rapid field-based species identification- Develop and apply computational pipelines for molecular species identification and insect community analysis- Assess responses of pest and beneficial insect communities to rye resilience strategies and integrate morphological and molecular monitoring data- Contribute to interdisciplinary research within the SiProtect consortium and develop new approaches for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring- Publish research findings in international journals and present results at scientific conferences and project meetingsYour profile- Completed Master’s degree in entomology, biology, ecology, molecular biology, biodiversity research or a related discipline- Good knowledge of the major insect orders and families of the German fauna and experience using taxonomic identification literature- Basic practical experience in molecular biology, ideally including DNA extraction, polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and gel documentation- Interest in and ideally initial experience with DNA barcoding, metabarcoding or molecular species identification- Basic programming skills in R and/or Python- Experience handling dried or ethanol-preserved entomological specimens is an advantage- Ability to organize research activities independently and work in a structured and reliable manner- Strong communication skills and an interest in interdisciplinary and collaborative research- Valid Class B driving licence and willingness to undertake fieldwork- Good written and spoken English, German skills are an advantageWhat you can expectThis position offers the opportunity to combine field entomology, molecular biology, metabarcoding, nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics within an interdisciplinary research project. You will contribute to a scientifically relevant question at the interface of crop resilience, biodiversity and sustainable agriculture, while developing a transferable methodological approach for field-based insect monitoring.We look forward to welcoming a curious and collaborative researcher who is keen to develop new methods and contribute their own ideas to SiProtect.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Would you like to apply?If so, please upload your complete and detailed application materials (cover letter, current resume, copies of your educational and employment certificates, if available) in electronic form as a single PDF file by 22 November 2026  to the careers page on our website:https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/﻿Please note that applications for this position can only be accepted if they are submitted via our online application portal. This ensures that your application is processed correctly and can be considered as part of the selection procedure. Applications sent by email to the recruiting team or directly to individual staff members cannot be considered.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.deContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainIf you have any technical questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Dr. Lara-Sophie Dey at lara-sophie.dey@senckenberg.de.For any questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact us atrecruiting@senckenberg.de.

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionExciting challenges. Quick decisions. Real users waiting. As an Associate Principal, Product Operations (Enterprise Device Management), you’ll own the global fleet of Android devices that restaurants use to receive and manage orders. You’ll keep configurations, rollouts, and support running smoothly across all our markets, and help shape where our device ecosystem goes next.The Global Vendor Operations team is made up of smart, driven people from around the world who work closely with our entities to help every local and regional operations team perform efficiently. We support senior management and local teams in keeping operations running smoothly. We also track how restaurant partners experience our products and services globally, and turn those insights into feature requirements for the product roadmap.As part of our Vendor Team, you’ll be the driving force behind the success of thousands of restaurants, shops, and local businesses. Your contributions will empower vendors with advanced tools to manage their operations, boosting their visibility and reach. Every feature you help build will create growth opportunities for businesses of all sizes, strengthening Delivery Hero’s ecosystem and impact.- Own our global restaurant device fleet, from allocation and provisioning to lifecycle management across all markets, and own the Key Results and initiatives that improve it, aligned with stakeholders on shared quarterly goals.- Operate and enhance our Device Management ecosystem (Android OS and devices), covering configuration, enrollment, policy and compliance management, account setup, incident and ticket troubleshooting, device support, and country-specific change requests.- Plan and run global software rollouts, including app updates, firmware upgrades, staged rollouts, rollback strategies, and post-deployment monitoring, and validate Android devices, firmware versions, and MDM configurations before release. Own projects that improve cost or efficiency.- Independently manage mid- and senior-level stakeholders across global and local operations teams, and work with the MDM Product Owner to develop integrations with internal systems and improve operational workflows.- Contribute to the product roadmap with analysis, stakeholder perspectives, and domain expertise.- Guide the day-to-day work of junior team members, share best practices beyond your own scope, and build transparency through documentation, knowledge bases, training materials, and efficient ticketing processes. On-call support for our global user base is part of the role when required.Qualifications- 6+ years of relevant experience managing large-scale Android device environments, including both consumer and B2B devices.- In-depth knowledge of an MDM platform, ideally SOTI MobiControl.- A solid understanding of networking technologies and concepts, including TCP/IP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and mobile network connectivity.- Proven ability to manage stakeholders independently at mid and senior levels in a global, multicultural environment.- You work well in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly as priorities change.- You are analytical, independent, and communicative, with fluent English.Nice to have- Hands-on experience with other enterprise-scale MDM solutions, such as VMware Workspace ONE / AirWatch or Ivanti / MobileIron.- Additional languages.Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank,  Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)  and check out more information about moving to Berlin.- Ready to prepare for your interview? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire)  If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You join a team that is being built right now. Transformation of Industry is setting up a dedicated Function Controlling for the first time, and you are part of it from the start. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. A standalone company needs its own transparency on the cost of its central functions — and that is exactly what this team delivers.You begin the day by reviewing the latest forecast for one of TI's central functions. Headcount, external spend and project costs have moved, and the functional leadership team needs a clear view of the financial impact. You discuss the key drivers, challenge assumptions and agree on actions. Later, you prepare the monthly performance review, coordinate inputs with local controllers and work with colleagues on a more efficient reporting solution. You are close to the business, comfortable with detail and able to turn numbers into a concise management message.This is a rare moment to join. A new company is being built, and with it a new Finance organization: the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is developing into the Corporate FP&A department of that company, an organization of more than 100 finance professionals. Within it, the Function Controlling team is defining common standards for planning, reporting, performance management and allocations — and you help shape them while owning the day-to-day business partnering for your functions. In this position you report directly to the Head of Function ControllingHow You’ll Make an Impact * Act as Finance Business Partner for corporate functions such as IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement or Finance, supporting their leaders in financial and performance decisions* Coordinate budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing and mid-term planning for assigned functions, ensuring alignment with local and regional controllers* Analyze cost, headcount, project and resource developments, explain deviations, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure consistent planning, reporting and data quality* Prepare management reports, performance reviews and decision-support materials, and support business cases, investment assessments and ad-hoc analyses for functional initiatives* Challenge spending plans and identify, quantify and track efficiency measures, supporting sound financial decisions and effective resource allocation* Develop allocation, charging and governance concepts, and improve controlling processes through standardization, automation and digital reportingWhat You Bring* A university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field* Longstanding experience in controlling, FP&A, cost controlling, function controlling or finance business partnering, with solid knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost center controlling and variance analysis* An analytical and structured approach, combining attention to detail with a clear understanding of the broader business context* A proactive, hands-on attitude and the flexibility to work effectively in a changing organization with a high workload* Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and follow topics through to resolution, combined with good Excel and PowerPoint skills; knowledge of SAP, Power BI, SAC or comparable tools is a plus* Fluent English; additional languages are an asset but not requiredAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.You do not need to tick every box. You will lead stakeholder management, requirements gathering, and prioritization, then translate those needs into robust system configurations and integration solutions.You will operate hands-on where required and effectively direct/collaborate with support teams to deliver line integrations on time and at quality. system configuration work and/or lead the support team in delivering the required integrations for new and existing lines- Mentor, coach, and upskill engineering teams on shop-floor production identify gaps, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for better system enablement and standardization- Create and maintain high-quality process maps, training and integration documentation- Provide track record of leading requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and delivery of system configurations/integrations for production environments- Demonstrated ability to work hands-on with systems while effectively directing and developing support teams- Experience mentoring others on shop-floor production processes and bridging process engineering knowledge into IT/systems work- Strong organizational, interpersonal, presentation, and senior-level stakeholder management skills- Experience using Jira (or similar) for requirements, backlog, and delivery tracking- Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage multiple high-priority workstreams, and thrive in a fast-paced production launch environment- Excellent communication skills in English (German is a strong plus)- Willingness and ability to spend significant time on the shop floor working directly with production, process, and support teams.- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and prioritization skills with high attention jobs.occupation: Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: What to ExpectWe are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer, Electrical, to join the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is an individual contributor role. You report to the mechanical failure analysis lead. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. We need an electrical engineer with industry experience, not a new graduate, to identify and characterize electrical failures. You use a multimeter, an oscilloscope, and other basic electrical test equipment to confirm the symptom, isolate the fault, and support root cause with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality. The right person is comfortable on the bench: probing boards, reading a schematic well enough to troubleshoot, and explaining what they found. Manufacturing experience is a strong plus. That includes production test, yield, process, or factory debug.?What You’ll Do- Debug and troubleshoot analog and digital systems with a digital multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and related bench equipment. - Confirm and recreate failures seen in engineering, production, and the field. - Drive root cause from the first report toward a countermeasure, with the original design engineers and the other failure analysis engineers. - Use the analytical tools the case needs, including functional test, electrical debug, and X-ray. - Design experiments to test a theory, and run them yourself or with the technician. - Document findings and investigation status. Report root cause and the relevant facts to engineering and manufacturing. - Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs. - Partner with manufacturing on production and yield-related electrical issues that come into the lab.?What You’ll Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. - 1-3 years of industry experience in electrical debug, test, manufacturing, or a related hands-on role. This is not a new-graduate role. Internships and coursework alone are not enough. - Hands-on use of a digital multimeter and an oscilloscope, and experience with power supplies and other common electrical test equipment. - Able to read a schematic and troubleshoot analog and digital circuitry at a basic to intermediate level. - Strong written and spoken English. - Self-driven, structured, and comfortable in a fast-paced lab. - Preferred: experience with common failure analysis techniques. - Preferred: manufacturing experience (production test, yield debug, process engineering, or factory electrical troubleshooting). - Preferred: soldering and rework on PCBAs. - Preferred: familiarity with common digital protocols (I2C, CAN, LIN).?Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.occupation: Lead Failure Analysis Engineer, Mechanical / Mechatronics (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: What to ExpectWe are looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer to lead the failure analysis team in Berlin (Tesla Engineering Germany). This is the team lead. The electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician report to you. The team finds root cause and contributing factors, so Tesla can reduce field, production, and development issues. You work with design, manufacturing, quality, and other engineering teams, across vehicle and energy products, including current models and products still in development. The role is hands-on. You own electromechanical failure analysis yourself, and you run the lab. You confirm and recreate failures, lead teardowns, and use optical microscopy, X-ray, and mechanical sample preparation to identify failure mechanisms. You report root cause and propose countermeasures with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and the other failure analysis engineers. The right person has several years of industry experience, is comfortable taking assemblies apart and putting them back together, and can connect what they see under a microscope or on an X-ray to how the part was designed and built. A materials science background is preferred.?What You’ll Do- Lead the failure analysis team and laboratory. Manage operations, lab workflows, equipment, and the two people who report to you: the electrical failure analysis engineer and the failure analysis technician. - Drive failure analysis of electromechanical assemblies from the first report through root cause and countermeasure, including failure confirmation, recreation, and teardown inspection. - Use optical microscopes, 2D X-ray, and related inspection tools to characterize defects in mechanical and electromechanical hardware. - Prepare mechanical samples (sectioning, grinding, polishing) so failure interfaces can be inspected, and document what you find. - Disassemble and reassemble electromechanical assemblies while keeping the original form and function. - Design and run experiments to test a hypothesis, either yourself or with the technician. - Document inspections, replication tests, and teardowns in written reports, images, and the project tracking system. - Work with Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers on containment and corrective action. - Bring prior failure experience into design reviews and DFMEAs.?What You’ll Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Materials Science, or equivalent experience. A materials science background is preferred. - 3-5 years of industry experience in failure analysis, reliability, product development, or a related hands-on engineering role. This is not a new-graduate role. - Hands-on experience with optical microscopes, X-ray inspection, and teardown of mechanical or electromechanical assemblies. - Able to take an assembly down to its subcomponents and explain what the parts are and how they work. - Able to fully disassemble and reassemble electromechanical assemblies without losing function or form. - Experience with mechanical sample preparation (saws, grinders, polishers) and with clear documentation: photos, optical images, and written reports. - Strong written and spoken English. Able to explain a failure mechanism clearly to design and manufacturing stakeholders. - Self-driven, structured, and comfortable in a fast-paced lab. - Preferred: tensile test, pressure or leak test, machine shop equipment, CAN or LIN, and oscilloscope.?Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. Guidance regarding professional recognition, German language learning, visa procedures, and relocation may be provided, depending on the employer's arrangements.Key Responsibilities- Assess patients' physical, cognitive, psychological, and functional abilities.- Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.- Provide therapeutic interventions to improve daily living skills and independence.- Support patients recovering from injuries, illnesses, neurological conditions, or developmental challenges.- Monitor treatment progress and document therapeutic outcomes.- Collaborate with physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals.- Educate patients and their families on therapeutic exercises and everyday activities.- Maintain accurate patient records and comply with German healthcare standards.Requirements- Completed qualification or degree in Ergotherapy/Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution.- Relevant professional experience is an advantage; motivated recent graduates may also be considered.- Willingness to relocate to Germany.- Willingness to learn German and achieve the language level required for professional recognition and employment.- Motivation to complete the professional recognition process in Germany.- Strong communication skills, empathy, patience, and a patient-focused approach.- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.Opportunities for International ApplicantsDepending on the employer and individual circumstances, support may include:- Guidance with recognition of foreign professional qualifications.- Assistance with German language courses.- Information and support regarding visa and work permit procedures.- Relocation guidance and help with settling in Germany.- Assistance with accommodation arrangements, where available.- Opportunities for long-term professional development.What We Offer- Employment opportunities in Germany's healthcare sector.- A professional and supportive working environment.- Opportunities to develop clinical skills and gain international work experience.- Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, location, and employer.- Potential long-term career opportunities in Germany.How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit:- An updated CV in English or German.- Copies of educational certificates and professional qualifications.- Evidence of relevant work experience, if available.- German language certificates, if available.- Information about current country of residence and willingness to relocate.Take the next step in your career and start your journey as an Ergotherapist in Germany!International candidates are encouraged to apply. Employment is subject to the applicable professional recognition, language, immigration, and work authorization requirements in Germany.Important information for applicants from abroadIn Germany, the profession of Ergotherapeut/in is regulated. Before working under the professional title, applicants generally need recognition of their foreign qualification and authorization to use the professional title.- Qualification recognition: The responsible authority depends on the German federal state where you intend to work.- German language: Employers and recognition authorities may require German proficiency. B2 is a useful target, although the exact requirements can vary.- Visa and relocation: Requirements depend on your nationality, qualifications, and circumstances.- Job opportunities: Hospitals, rehabilitation centres, private therapy practices, care facilities, and paediatric therapy centres may recruit international professionals.

We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/286160?source=BA

jobs.occupation: Researcher (m/f/d) in Deep-Sea Biodiversity and Taxonomy (Meeresbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Marine Zoology at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as 06 January 2027:Researcher (m/f/d) in Deep-Sea Biodiversity and Taxonomy(Part-Time: 50%)Employment scope: 50% Part-TimeType of contract: Limited to 1 year (06 January 2027 to 10 February 2028)Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the  Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services  along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG), the HADALquake project investigates how earthquake-induced submarine landslides affect life and elemental cycles in the deepest parts of the ocean. The project focuses on comparing conditions before and after recent earthquakes in the Kermadec and Tonga trench systems in the South Pacific.Your tasks- The scientist is primarily responsible for processing of the benthic animal groups:- Assistance in sorting the benthic material- Quantitative extraction and determination of the macrofauna with special consideration of an abundant, selected taxon, such as the Isopoda or another peracarid taxon.- Biodiversity analysis and analysis of biogeography of the Isopoda- Biogeographical comparison of selected taxon with previous data from the South Pacific- Preparation of individuals for genetic analysis (barcoding gene fragments and other gene fragments to support taxonomic questions and phylogenetic analysesYour profile- A completed university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in biology, marine biology or a related discipline.- Research experience in the taxonomy, biodiversity and biogeography of deep-sea benthic invertebrates, particularly isopod crustaceans.- Practical experience in scientific research cruises, biological sample processing and species identification.- Experience in biodiversity data management and statistical analyses using R.- Good written and spoken English.- Willingness and availability to participate in the research expedition: 06 January 2027, departure in Suva, Fidschi to 10 February 2028, arriving in Wellington, New Zealand.Desirable skills- Knowledge of deep-sea sampling. Identification of deep-sea Isopoda, Amphipoda and/or another peracarid taxon (Crustacea, Malacostraca).We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement  – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) electronically as a single PDF by 08.11.2026. Please submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Angelika Brandt at recruiting@senckenberg.de

jobs.occupation: Research Software Engineer (all genders) HPC & Pferformance Portability (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position asResearch Software Engineer (all genders) HPC & Performance PortabilityYour tasksA key focus for DKRZ is the development of the climate and weather model ICON, and its further preparation for current and future HPC systems. Within the European PHOENIX project, we aim to develop a maintainable, performance-portable version of ICON that runs efficiently on heterogeneous CPU and GPU architectures. In this context, you will contribute to the development, integration, and optimisation of ICON on the largest European supercomputers.Your work will focus on several aspects of performance-portable scientific software, depending on your background and interests. This includes integrating ICON components based on different programming approaches, such as C++/Kokkos, DaCe, and gt4py, improving their interoperability, and enabling efficient execution on different HPC architectures, particularly NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, but also possible future compute architectures.Further areas of work include improving ICON's efficiency and scalability at very high spatial resolutions. You may also explore the use of mixed precision and AI-oriented hardware features for climate models, or improve the efficient concurrent execution and coupling of ICON with other components. The specific focus of your work will be determined together with the project team, allowing complementary contributions to the different development tasks.Qualifications / Experiences● Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering, or a related field with a clear focus on scientific computing● Experience in high-performance computing, performance portability, and optimising scientific applications for modern hardware● Experience with scientific software development, ideally involving large, collaboratively developed applications● Programming experience with Fortran or C/C++, ideally in the context of scientific or parallel applications● Experience with parallel programming, for example MPI or GPU programming● Familiarity with performance-portable programming approaches such as DaCe, gt4py, or similar technologies is an advantage● Programming experience under Unix/Linux, including scripting languages such as Python or Bash; experience with HPC environments, performance analysis, or code optimisation is an advantage● Motivation to support open, collaborative, and community-oriented software development● Very good communication skills and knowledge of EnglishEmployment conditionsWe offer work in interdisciplinary teams and excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific development goals and requirements from our project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to explore and implement solutions at the interface between high-performance computing, scientific software engineering, and Earth system modelling. Participation in international conferences, project meetings, and hackathons provides opportunities for further training, exchange with the international HPC community, and presentation of your own results wherever meaningful.We are based in Hamburg, but want to create a suitable working environment by offering flexible working hours and location (up to 100% work from home within Germany). Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. You can ideally start already in February 2027, but the exact starting date can be agreed individually. The position is financed by third-party funded projects and is limited until the end of 2029.Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portal https://dkrz.softgarden.io/de/vacancies.Application deadline : Priority will be given to applications received by 30 November 2026.Questions? Dr. Jan Frederik Engels (engels@dkrz.de) and Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

Constructor University is a private, state-accredited, English-language research university located on a green, 34-hectare residential campus in Bremen, Germany. Founded in 2001, the university offers Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programs across three schools: the School of Science, the School of Computer Science and Engineering, and the School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Constructor University is home to approximately 2,500 students and researchers from more than 120 countries. All teaching, research, and academic administration are conducted in English, within an international community that is among the most diverse of any university in Germany. According to the 2027 Times Higher Education World University Rankings, Constructor University ranks among the top 17 percent of universities worldwide in both Social Sciences and Engineering; moreover, it scores 92 out of 100 for International Outlook and 84 out of 100 for Industry. The indicators that reflect both the quality of its academic environment and the breadth of its engagement with the wider world.The School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences brings together management, behavioral science, data analytics, and decision theory under one roof. Its programs, ranging from undergraduate studies in International Business Administration to the MBA, MSc in Data Science for Society and Business, and doctoral education, attract professionally ambitious and internationally minded students. The School is also home to approximately 50 doctoral researchers, contributing to an active and growing research environment. Marketing represents a strategic new direction for the School, and this position offers an opportunity to help shape the field from the outset, develop an independent research agenda in a genuinely interdisciplinary environment, and contribute to a School that is actively expanding.Constructor University invites applications for the following position, to be filled ideally by Fall 2027:Assistant Professor of Marketing (f/m/d)(Full-time; 38,5h/week, tenure-track)School of Business, Social and Decision SciencesYour Responsibilities:In this position, you will support our research and teaching activities in the field of Marketing. The successful candidate will be teaching courses (for example Digital Marketing), supporting and advising students on their studies and supervising Bachelor, Master’s and PhD theses and research projects.Possible areas of interest are: - Design and teach innovative, contemporary modules in Marketing at undergraduate and master’s levels, including within MBA, MA, and MSc programs.- Engage, advise, and mentor students; supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s theses, and doctoral research- Build and sustain an active research agenda with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals- Establish a research group and pursue external funding from national and international sources- Contribute to curriculum development, new program initiatives, and departmental serviceThe university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop transdisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners.Your Qualifications and Experience:- PhD in Marketing or a closely related field- Evidence of high-quality research and a strong publication pipeline- Ability to design and teach core Marketing courses at undergraduate and graduate levels- Expertise in areas such as Digital Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behavior, AI in Marketing, or related fields is particularly welcome- Readiness to pursue external research funding and contribute to collaborative research projects- Ability and willingness to supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s theses and contribute to doctoral supervision- Willingness to work and teach in a multicultural, English-speaking academic environment- Excellent written and spoken English and strong intercultural competenceWhat you can expect at Constructor University: Constructor University guarantees the academic freedom of every faculty member. Junior faculty receive formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, and dedicated start-up and research group budgets to help establish their work. The university has an active portfolio of Horizon Europe and Erasmus+ funded projects and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration across its three schools, creating genuine opportunities for joint initiatives and externally funded research. Beyond the academic environment, you will find a campus that is genuinely close-knit: small classes, direct faculty-student engagement, and a community where diversity is lived rather than declared. Language courses and sports facilities are part of everyday life on campus. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings, in the CHE Ranking, the most comprehensive and detailed ranking of the German-speaking higher education landscape, Constructor University has achieved top placements every year since its first participation in 2005. The campus is located in Bremen. Bremen is a vibrant, livable Hanseatic city with an international character, affordable by European standards, well connected by rail and air, and home to a growing academic and innovation community. Relocating here is, for most, a pleasant discovery.The position is tenure-track, with review after an initial three-year contract, followed by a second three-year contract. Successful evaluation leads to permanence and typically promotion to Associate Professor level. Constructor University is an equal opportunity employer and particularly welcomes applications that would improve the university’s faculty profile with reference to gender and national origin.Your Application:If you have any questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Çağrı Bulut via Mail (cbulut@constructor.university (https://mailto:cbulut@constructor.university) ).Constructor University offers full equal opportunity to all qualified applications. We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. We especially encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups.Please upload your documents in a single PDF document, including a letter of motivation stating your field of expertise, curriculum vitae, teaching portfolio, publication record, copies of certificates and diplomas, certification of English proficiency (optional), and the names and addresses of two referees in our application management system.The deadline for submission of applications 15.01.2027.The review of applications will begin immediately.Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

and Design Assurance Responsibilities- Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the documented Design Assurance System — hands-on, not just on paper.- Ensure that all design work is undertaken in accordance with the Design Assurance System, BCAR A8-21, and other applicable airworthiness regulations.- Ensure that all design activities remain within the scope of the company's approved design privileges.- Ensure that for all design work, compliance with the applicable type certification basis or equivalent is properly demonstrated and verified.- Ensure that flight testing is carried out in accordance with regulatory requirements.- Sign Declarations of Compliance after satisfactory verification of compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements.- Confirm that all design procedures distance.- Manage and coordinate external Compliance Verification Engineers.- Provide technical oversight and interface to the independent Head of Airworthiness function.- Ensure qualification, competency, and training of engineering and certification personnel.- Coordinate and manage design, development, certification, and flight test programmes with internal and external stakeholders.- Provide strong project management across design, development, certification, and flight test programmes — planning, scheduling, and managing resources with internal and external stakeholders to keep programmes on time and on budget.- Provide technical authority for design decisions, certification strategies, and design changes, personally stepping in when problems get stuck between departments.- Ensure complete, controlled, and traceable design documentation for certification, production, continued airworthiness, and future investigations.- Provide technical support to production, quality, customer support, and incident investigations where required.- Actively identify inefficiencies and gaps in existing processes and drive their resolution with an entrepreneurial, get-it-done mindset.Required Qualifications- Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical qualification.- Extensive professional experience in a regulated industrial environment; experience gained within a German company as well as senior-level experience from the automotive industry are highly desirable.- Proven track record in leading engineering teams, driving technical decisions, and taking full accountability for results, timelines, and compliance.- Strong and practical expertise in complex systems engineering, including electrical and avionics integration.- Solid experience with regulatory frameworks and compliance environments (e.g. DULV BUT, BCAR Section T, UK CAA, FAA, CAAC).- A true problem solver: someone energized rather than deterred by open, unresolved technical challenges, who finds pragmatic paths forward instead of waiting for perfect conditions.- Hands-on, execution-focused leadership style with a high level of assertiveness and decision-making authority — someone who rolls up their sleeves rather than delegating every difficult problem.- Ability to challenge existing structures, enforce standards, and drive implementation across interfaces (Engineering, Certification, Production, Quality).- High level of ownership, resilience, and confidence when operating in complex, regulated, and time-critical environments.- An intrapreneurial mindset: you treat the Design Organisation as if it were your own venture, take initiative beyond the formal job description, and are comfortable building and improving processes rather than just following them.- English, German & Chinese: mandatory (written and spoken).Benefits- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.- Supportive and international team culture.- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then join AutoGyro GmbH.We are the world market leader in the development, production and sale of gyrocopters and work with partners in more than 40 countries. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high degree of vertical integration and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we are actively shaping the future.Since our foundation in 1999, we have grown steadily and now employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d): Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 January2027:PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d):Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementitel (m/f/d)(Part-Time)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: PhD position (65%) / PostDoc (up to 60%)Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 4 years, until 31.12.20230Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.As part of the Centre, the group “Global Land Systems and Biodiversity” takes a system perspective on how production, trade and consumption of food and other biomass products affect ecosystems and people.The VEBITA project, conducted jointly by SGN, the Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE) brings together researchers and practice partners to work towards utilizing animal movement data for early-warning systems for nature conservation. By analyzing GPS and sensor data from animals with statistical and AI-based methods, VEBITA aims to detect how animal behaviors change in response to land use, climate change, habitat loss, infrastructure development, and other environmental pressures.The adverstised position focuses on the effects of livestock management on wildlife movements contributes a use-case for state-of-the art animal movement data. Currently, livestock keeping has the largest spatial footprint of all land uses and the global biomass of mammalian livestock exceeds that of all remaining wild mammals by an order of magnitude. How and where livestock are kept greatly impacts the movements of the remaining wild mammals.In this context, we seek to develop a refined biodiversity footprint approach that captures how different livestock management strategies impact movement of wild mammals and how management can be adapted to achieve more sustainable outcomes. This subproject is part of VEBITA’s transdisciplinary focus, and the design of the novel footprint approach will consider perspectives of different relevant societal stakeholder groups such as livestock farmers, conservationists, and regulators. Results and insights of this work will also feed back to international science-policy debates on how conservation and human activities can be aligned in the future.Your tasks- Advance existing biodiversity footprint approaches in the context of livestock production and wildlife movement- Classify global livestock management systems- Analyze global patterns of how livestock keeping influences movements of wild mammals- Actively engage in exchange and cooperation within VEBITA’s inter- and transdisciplinary project team- Participate in project meetings and contribute to project reporting- Publish results in international journals in cooperation with the project teamYour profile- MSc degree (or equivalent) for application for a PhD position or PhD degree for application as postdoctoral researcher in a relevant field, e.g., sustainability science, physical geography, ecology or another relevant field- Programming skills (R, Python or similar), familiarity in working with heterogenous datasets and their analysis- Excellent English language skills- Interest in working in an inter- and transdisciplinary project- Interest in applied science at the science-policy interfaceDesirable skills- Experience with stakeholder interactionsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application as a single PDF by 19 November 2026, stating the reference number Ref. #11-26021, including:- cover letter describing your motivation to apply for this position- detailed CV- contact details of two potential references- all academic credentials and certificatesPlease submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.If you have any specific questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Thomas Kastner at thomas.kastner@senckenberg.de.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact xxxxx atvorname.nachname@senckenberg.deFor data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.Application documents will also be made available to members of the selection committee from Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE), solely for the purpose of assessing applications and selecting candidates.

The location of the available position is in a Senckenberg institute about 40 kilometers east of Frankfurt in Gelnhausen, a historic town accessible via public transport (rail and bus).We are looking for enthusiastic ecologists with a background in broad-scale biodiversity change, community ecology, macroecology, metacommunities, and/or analysis of ecological time series.The two positions are embedded in one or more of the following projects:1. Synthesis Center on Freshwater Biodiversity Change in Europe The Synthesis Center brings together and supports a broad variety of researchers and practitioners investigating a broad variety of fundamental and applied ecological questions, with a particular focus on broad-scale and long-term biodiversity change, community ecology, freshwater ecology, time series analyses, multiple stressor impacts, and conservation (see doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06400-1 for an example). Data for > 30,000 freshwater biodiversity time series across 30 European countries have already been compiled from rivers and lakes, covering invertebrates, fish, macrophytes, diatoms, and benthic algae, in collaboration with a large pan-European network of > 200 researchers.
